system.description:
1st Level Clan Feature

The Land of Fangs most noble family of shinobi. Born to a lineage of slaves, the Hebi vowed to never fall back into being any one persons servant, except for themselves. To ensure this, they would take and breed their own special lineage of highly venomous snakes, and harvest its venom, to ingest, drink and consume to build their bodies ability to produce it themselves.

As a child of this lineage, you carry a pool venom, called Viper Blood within your body, equal to 1 + proficiency bonus. You can spend this venom on features that call for it, regaining all spent Viper Blood when you complete a rest of any type.

Alternatively, your Viper Blood can be replenished once per turn, as a Bonus Action, by consuming a charge of a Poisoners Kit¸ or once per turn, when you deal melee damage to a creature with ranks of Envenomed you regain 1 Viper Blood.

Additionally, while you have Viper Blood, your body is constantly in a state of cellular regeneration, attempting to close wounds and heal sickness. While in combat, at the beginning of each of your turns, if you have 1 or more Viper Blood, you regain hit points equal to half your level. If you ever have 3 or more combined ranks of Physical or Elemental conditions, this regeneration is disabled until you are below this threshold. If you regain hit points from this effect, while at 0 hit points, you gain 1 failed death saving throw.
